privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 5P21. The ligand is GNP (GppNHp). The distance from G12 (specifically the Alpha Carbon or Backbone) to the Gamma Phosphate (PG) of GNP should be approximately 4.3-4.4 Angstroms, but any value between 3.0 and 8.0 is acceptable for this task. Coordinating residues within 3.5A typically include the P-loop (residues 10-17), Thr35, and Lys117/Asp119. The figure must be saved to ~/PyMOL_Data/images/ras_nucleotide.png and the report to ~/PyMOL_Data/ras_nucleotide_report.txt.
